walkthroughs.body_html: Plyometric training — box jumps, bounding, hurdle hops — develops power. Used by basketball players, sprinters, volleyball spikers. High impact, so good technique and rest between sessions are essential.
For strength: 4-6 reps × 3-5 sets at 70-85% 1RM. For endurance: 15-20 reps × 3 sets at 50-60% 1RM. For power: 3-6 explosive reps × 3-5 sets. Rest 2-5 mins between heavy sets, 30-60 s for endurance.

Marathon runner — continuous. 100 m sprinter — interval + plyometric. Football player — fartlek + circuit. Rugby forward — weight training + plyometric. The principle of specificity guides every choice.
